pictures.scene: Velazquez, Saint John the Evangelist on Patmos — John seated in a white robe with a quill over an open book and his eagle in the shadow behind him while a robed figure and a many headed serpent appear on a cloud of light above, then i heard a loud voice from the temple saying to the seven angels, go, pour out on the earth the seven bowls of god's wrath
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_saint_john_the_evangelist_on_patmos

pictures.scene: Steen, The Sick Woman — a woman slumped back in her chair in grey blue and red with her hand pressed to her stomach while a doctor at the right holds a glass up to the light, so the first angel went and poured out his bowl on the earth, and loathsome malignant sores broke out on those who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image
pictures.name: pd_steen_sick_woman

pictures.scene: Courbet, The Wave — a dark green black wave rearing and breaking into white foam under a heavy grey sky with no shore and no boat in sight, and the second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it turned to blood like that of the dead, and every living thing in the sea died
pictures.name: pd_courbet_the_wave

pictures.scene: Corrodi, Banks of the Nile — a minaret and palms standing over a mud brick quay with feluccas on still water and the pyramids on the far bank in the red light of sunset while robed women fill their jars at the edge, and the third angel poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they turned to blood
pictures.name: pd_corrodi_banks_of_the_nile

pictures.scene: Bol, The Angel Appearing to Elijah — an angel in a white robe bending down with a dark flask in one hand and the other hand raised in speech over Elijah asleep in red under the tree, and i heard the angel of the waters say, righteous are you, o holy one, who is and was
pictures.name: pd_bol_the_angel_appearing_to_elijah

pictures.scene: Gerome, The Christian Martyrs Last Prayer — a black maned lion standing alone on the arena sand before the crowded tiers with the stakes still smoking at the left, because you have brought these judgments, for they have spilled the blood of saints and prophets
pictures.name: pd_gerome_martyrs

pictures.scene: King David Kneeling before an Altar — a crowned king in armour and a jewelled gold cope kneeling with his hand on his breast and his harp set down beside him while an angel hovers at the left and an open book is held out at the right, and you have given them blood to drink as they deserve, and i heard the altar reply
pictures.name: pd_king_david_kneeling_before_an_altar

pictures.scene: Martin, Joshua Commanding the Sun to Stand Still — the sun held open in a ring of black cloud with its rays falling across a vast white terraced city while armies wind down the dark valley below, yes, lord god almighty, true and just are your judgments, then the fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun
pictures.name: pd_martin_joshua_commanding_the_sun_to_stand_still

pictures.scene: Haag, Danger in the Desert — a robed man with a spear standing with his back to us beside his kneeling laden camel on burning yellow sand under a bleached sky, and it was given power to scorch the people with fire, and the people were scorched by intense heat
pictures.name: pd_haag_danger_in_the_desert

pictures.scene: Steen, Beware of Luxury — a woman in black leaning over a seated man with her finger raised in warning while a pig noses a rose on the floor among dropped cards and a fallen hat, and they cursed the name of god, who had authority over these plagues, yet they did not repent and give him glory
pictures.name: pd_steen_beware_of_luxury

pictures.scene: Darkness at Noon — the sun smothered behind a bank of heavy black cloud over dark hills with the last light draining out of the valley, and the fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom was plunged into darkness
pictures.name: darkness_at_noon

pictures.scene: Bocklin, The Plague — Death with a scythe riding a black winged beast down a narrow street while figures in red and white fall in the doorways below, and men began to gnaw their tongues in anguish, and curse the god of heaven for their pains and sores
pictures.name: pd_bocklin_pest

pictures.scene: Goodall, The Subsiding of the Nile — shrinking channels winding through a wide mud flat with a pyramid beyond while a woman stoops to fill her jar with a boy at her side, yet they did not repent of their deeds, and the sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river euphrates
pictures.name: pd_goodall_subsiding_nile

pictures.scene: Lear, Masada on the Dead Sea — the red orange cliff wall of the rock standing out of a dry empty shore in low evening light with no figure anywhere on it, and its water was dried up to prepare the way for the kings of the east, and i saw three unclean spirits that looked like frogs
pictures.name: pd_lear_masada_dead_sea

pictures.scene: Raphael, Saint George and the Dragon — an armoured knight on a white horse driving his lance into the mouth of a dark winged dragon at the edge of a wood, coming out of the mouths of the dragon, the beast, and the false prophet, these are demonic spirits that perform signs and go out to all the kings of the earth
pictures.name: pd_raphael_saint_george_and_the_dragon

pictures.scene: Altdorfer, The Battle of Alexander at Issus — a Latin tablet hung on red ribbons above an immense plain packed with pikes and banners and wheeling cavalry with lakes and mountains behind, to assemble them for battle on the great day of god the almighty, behold, i am coming like a thief
pictures.name: pd_altdorfer_the_battle_of_alexander_at_issus

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, The Night Watch — the militia company stepping forward out of the dark with the captain in black and a red sash beside the lieutenant in pale yellow while a musket is fired and the pikes go up behind, blessed is the one who remains awake and clothed, so that he will not go naked and let his shame be exposed
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_the_night_watch

pictures.scene: Uccello, The Battle of San Romano — a white warhorse rearing among levelled lances with fallen armour and broken staves underfoot and hounds running the brown fields above, and they assembled the kings in the place that in hebrew is called armageddon, then the seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air
pictures.name: pd_uccello_the_battle_of_san_romano

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, Christ in Glory — Christ seated in a deep blue mandorla ringed with small angel heads with His hand raised over a field of gold while crowned saints kneel on clouds at either side, and a loud voice came from the throne in the temple, saying, it is done
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_christ_in_glory

pictures.scene: Heade, Approaching Thunderstorm — a thin fork of lightning under a black bank of cloud over dead calm water with one man rowing a small boat and a furled white sail left on the shore, and there were flashes of lightning, and rumblings, and peals of thunder, and a great earthquake the likes of which had not occurred since men were upon the earth
pictures.name: pd_heade_approaching_thunderstorm

pictures.scene: Glama, The Earthquake — a priest in a white chasuble standing with his arms spread under walls broken off to the open sky while the hurt lie on the ground around him and the crowd looks up, so mighty was the great quake, the great city was split into three parts, and the cities of the nations collapsed
pictures.name: pd_glama_quake

pictures.scene: Bruegel, The Tower of Babel — the unfinished tower rising in tier upon tier of arches with scaffolding and cranes still standing on it and stonecutters at work on the blocks below, and god remembered babylon the great and gave her the cup of the wine of the fury of his wrath, then every island fled, and no mountain could be found
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_the_tower_of_babel

pictures.scene: Turner, The Fifth Plague of Egypt — a black storm wheeling over a white pyramid and a pale city with the whole sky bearing down on the ruins and the bare trees in the foreground, and great hailstones weighing almost a hundred pounds each rained down on them from above, and men cursed god for the plague of hail, because it was so horrendous
pictures.name: pd_turner_plague

lines.text: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple saying to the seven angels,
Go, pour out on the earth the seven bowls of God's wrath.
So the first angel went and poured out his bowl on the earth,
and loathsome, malignant sores broke out on those who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image.
And the second angel poured out his bowl into the sea,
and it turned to blood like that of the dead, and every living thing in the sea died.
And the third angel poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water,
and they turned to blood.
And I heard the angel of the waters say:
Righteous are You, O Holy One, who is and was,
because You have brought these judgments.
For they have spilled the blood of saints and prophets,
and You have given them blood to drink, as they deserve.
And I heard the altar reply:
Yes, Lord God Almighty, true and just are Your judgments.
Then the fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun,
and it was given power to scorch the people with fire.
And the people were scorched by intense heat,
and they cursed the name of God, who had authority over these plagues;
yet they did not repent and give Him glory.
And the fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast,
and its kingdom was plunged into darkness,
and men began to gnaw their tongues in anguish
and curse the God of heaven for their pains and sores;
yet they did not repent of their deeds.
And the sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates,
and its water was dried up to prepare the way for the kings of the East.
And I saw three unclean spirits that looked like frogs
coming out of the mouths of the dragon, the beast, and the false prophet.
These are demonic spirits that perform signs and go out to all the kings of the earth,
to assemble them for battle on the great day of God the Almighty.
Behold, I am coming like a thief.
Blessed is the one who remains awake and clothed,
so that he will not go naked and let his shame be exposed.
And they assembled the kings in the place that in Hebrew is called Armageddon.
Then the seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air,
and a loud voice came from the throne in the temple, saying,
It is done!
And there were flashes of lightning, and rumblings, and peals of thunder,
and a great earthquake the likes of which had not occurred since men were upon the earth,
so mighty was the great quake.
The great city was split into three parts, and the cities of the nations collapsed.
And God remembered Babylon the great and gave her the cup of the wine of the fury of His wrath.
Then every island fled, and no mountain could be found.
And great hailstones weighing almost a hundred pounds each rained down on them from above.
And men cursed God for the plague of hail, because it was so horrendous.
